cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not Why We Drifted
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation away from the real reason the relationship changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've found our wedding video. Let me cue it properly; don't start halfway through the speeches.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather discuss why we're living separately.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Listen to your father's opening first. The whole sentence, please, before we decide what he meant by 'good luck.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He meant this. Pause it. I don't want another speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Paused. We'll use the dancing section, then. Watch the cake table; I'll run it slowly so you can tell me whether your uncle actually hits it.
